pattern_update_rule: Every R4 finding must be classified as PHENOMENON_PATTERN, EVIDENCE_PIPELINE_PATTERN, NEGATIVE_PATTERN, or NO_PATTERN_CHANGE. No common-origin inference from documentary recurrence alone.
